channel.title: Music Business Worldwide (MBW) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music Business Worldwide (MBW) (musicbusinessworldwide.com)

item.title: Lucy Dickins, long-time agent for Adele and Mumford & Sons, to exit WME after seven years
item.description: Current Co-Head Kirk Sommer will continue to lead WME's Contemporary Music division. Source

item.title: Live Nation reaches settlement with DOJ in antitrust battle, Politico reports
item.description: Politico report was published Monday (March 9), citing three people familiar with the matter. Source

item.title: HYBE and Spotify strike global content partnership for K-pop video podcasts
item.description: HYBE will produce original podcast content through its in-house studio, with the first show launching later this month. Source

item.title: US radio broadcaster Cumulus Media files for bankruptcy to shed $600M in debt
item.description: The bankruptcy filing marks Cumulus’ second after previously filing for Chapter 11 in November 2017. It emerged from bankruptcy in June 2018. Source

item.title: Ed Sheeran’s lawyers push to end remaining ‘Thinking Out Loud’ copyright case
item.description: Sheeran's legal team argues the copyright registration underpinning the case was never valid. Source

item.title: AEG International Global Partnerships strengthens leadership team with key promotions
item.description: Georgina Iceton, Will Dowdy, and Matthew Zweck have each been promoted to Senior Vice President roles Source

item.title: GEMA vs. Suno: German court hears landmark AI music copyright case
item.description: A packed courtroom in Munich today heard oral proceedings in the copyright case brought by Germany's GEMA against AI music generator Suno. Source

item.title: Confirmed: Agent Lucy Dickins to join CAA after exiting WME
item.description: Dickins will serve on CAA's Managing Director committee, and will "continue working directly with top music artists." Source

item.title: Live Nation confirms settlement with the US Department of Justice; sets aside $280M for damages claims from states
item.description: Live Nation will be 'divesting its 13 exclusive booking agreements' with amphitheaters in the US Source

item.title: beatBread makes run of new appointments, including ex-Spotify and CD Baby execs
item.description: New hires from CD Baby, Spotify and Countsy bring finance, operations and AI expertise to the music funding company’s leadership team. Source
